name: IQGeo Name Address Updater
description: Fills and corrects address attributes of manholes and poles from the feature name (e.g. 'POLE R 1021 ARIZONA ST SE') through the IQGeo REST API (postal code and ZIP+4 can be taken from a PSA address export matched on street name, type and direction, or looked up from the USPS Addresses API), with preview, field-level selection, verification and undo.
